I can't calculate embedded emissions for this shipment because the factor table has no default value for CN 7201 produced in Brazil.

The ruleset requires the good's CN code and the country of production to both appear in the table. CN 7201 is listed only for Türkiye (1.85 tCO2e/t), China (1.66 tCO2e/t), and India (2.53 tCO2e/t). Brazil is not listed, so I have not produced an estimate.

To proceed, you would need one of the following:
- Confirmation that the production country is one of the listed countries, if Brazil was entered in error.
- A default SEE value for CN 7201 from Brazil, added to the factor table by the authorised source.
